name: send_email
description: Send an email to a contact. Use when user says 'email', 'send email to', 'message', etc. Contacts are looked up by name (e.g., 'Andrew', 'Mom', 'work') from config/contacts.json, or use a direct email address. IMPORTANT: Always compose the email body with proper context - start with a brief intro explaining who is sending and why (e.g., 'Hey! Boss asked me to share this song with you.' or 'Boss wanted you to see these search results.'), then include the actual content. Never send raw data without context. Rate limited to prevent duplicates.

to.description: Recipient name (from contacts list) or email address. Examples: 'Andrew', 'mom', 'john@example.com'

subject.description: Email subject line - make it descriptive (e.g., 'Song recommendation from Boss' not just 'Spotify')

body.description:
Email body. ALWAYS start with context: 1) Brief friendly intro mentioning who sent it and why, 2) Then the actual content. Example: 'Hey Andrew!

Boss wanted to share this song with you:

🎵 Song Name by Artist...'

image_url.description: Optional: URL of image to embed (e.g., album art from Spotify share)

link_url.description: Optional: Clickable link URL (e.g., Spotify track URL)

link_text.description: Optional: Display text for the link (default: 'Open Link')
